title: Paired configuration code lookup
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, and let $C,n,s$ be natural numbers such that $C$ is at least the number of states plus $6$ times the number of work tapes plus $5$. If Boolean strings $x,y$ each have length $n$, and $c,d$ are configurations on those respective inputs, then for any choice of one of the two strings and any coordinate of a configuration code, the bit at the corresponding position in the concatenation of their configuration codes equals the bit specified by that chosen configuration's code row at that coordinate.
